name: vercel-labs/agent-skills
summary: Vercel's agent skills for coding agents: React performance rules, web design and writing audits, view transitions and deployment.
description: Eight packaged agent skills in the Agent Skills format: vercel-optimize (Vercel cost and performance audits), react-best-practices (40+ rules across 8 categories), web-design-guidelines (100+ UI, accessibility and UX rules), writing-guidelines, react-native-guidelines, react-view-transitions, composition-patterns and vercel-deploy-claimable. Each skill is a SKILL.md folder with optional scripts and references; every change to a skill publishes an immutable GitHub release with a discovery index.
contains: 8 skills including vercel-optimize, react-best-practices and vercel-deploy-claimable
react-best-practices: 40+ React and Next.js performance rules in 8 categories
web-design-guidelines: 100+ UI rules for accessibility, focus, forms, animation and dark mode
writing-guidelines: 80+ documentation rules from the Vercel writing handbook
react-native-guidelines: 16 rules across performance, layout, animation and platform
react-view-transitions: View Transition API recipes and Next.js integration
